title: Find the connection that applies back pressure
description: Change arrival rate, processing capacity, and FlowFile size. The lab calculates which configured queue threshold is reached first and what the source observes.
modelNote: This is a deterministic queue-growth estimate, not a NiFi benchmark. It assumes steady rates and an initially empty connection. Real scheduling, batching, repository I/O, record parsing, network behavior, and cluster load must be measured with a representative flow.

presets.label: HTTP event intake
presets.detail: ListenHTTP accepts push traffic and can return HTTP 503 when its success connection cannot accept more FlowFiles.

presets.label: Large object transfer
presets.detail: A small object count can still fill the connection because the data-size threshold is evaluated independently.

presets.label: Balanced record flow
presets.detail: Downstream capacity is above the selected arrival rate, so an initially empty queue does not grow under the steady-rate model.
